headline: Garden Journal Ideas to Track Your Best Year
items: Note first and last frost dates
Record what you sowed and when
Sketch your beds each season
Log pests, weather and yields
Stick in seed packets and photos

headline: Your November Garden Checklist
items: Plant spring bulbs before the frost
Clear fallen leaves from beds
Cut back and mulch perennials
Clean and store pots and tools
Order seeds for next spring

headline: Best Cottage Garden Flowers for Beginners
items: Foxgloves for height and bees
Hardy geraniums for easy ground cover
Lupins and delphiniums for spires
Sweet peas for scent and cutting
Cosmos for colour until frost

headline: Cottage Garden Roses: 5 Tips for Success
items: Choose scented, repeat-flowering roses
Plant in full sun with rich soil
Underplant with catmint or lavender
Mulch each spring and feed well
Prune in late winter for new growth

headline: Cottage Garden Path Ideas You Will Love
items: Curve it for a winding feel
Use gravel, brick or old flagstones
Let thyme soften the edges
Add an arch with climbing roses
Keep it wide enough for two

headline: Raised Bed Garden Layout That Works
items: Keep beds 1.2 m wide to reach
Leave 60 cm paths between beds
Face long sides toward the sun
Put tall crops on the north side
Fill with a mix of soil and compost

headline: Herb Garden Ideas for Any Size Space
items: Grow herbs in pots by the door
Plant mint alone in its own pot
Pair thyme, sage and rosemary
Use a tiered stand for small spaces
Pick often to keep plants bushy
